scope: Static ELF DT_NEEDED audit of all shared objects and wheel bin executables; no Linux native code was executed on the macOS build host.
base_system_assumption: Operator CPython 3.11 base is Debian Bookworm (CPU) or its documented Linux GPU base with build-essential. glibc, libgcc, libstdc++ and libz are required from that base. Build-time native-import checks will fail if any is missing.
